dashboard_ui.overview_subtitle: Here's is overview of your business !

welcome.label: Welcome to OptimumERP
welcome.description: Your complete, privacy-first business management suite — powered by local AI. Manage your invoicing, purchases, inventory, expenses, contacts, and financial reporting from a single, elegant interface.
features: All-in-One ERP: Track sales, procurement, inventory, and analytics in one place.
Privacy-First AI: Your data never leaves your servers, keeping your records secure.
Multi-Organization: Easily manage multiple companies from a single account.

ai_assistant.label: AI Business Assistant
ai_assistant.description: Talk to your business data in plain English. The AI assistant is context-aware and deeply integrated with every module.
features: Natural Language: Say 'Create invoice for Acme Corp for 5 units of Product X'.
Local LLMs: Integrated with local Ollama or cloud Grok AI models.
Multi-Talented: Create documents, search logs, write reports, and send emails via chat.

billing.label: Sales & Invoicing
billing.description: Create professional documents and streamline your billing lifecycle.
features: Invoices & Quotes: Track Draft, Sent, Pending, and Accepted status.
One-Click Conversion: Instantly convert accepted quotes or proformas to final invoices.
Professional PDF/Email: Download templates, print UPI QR codes, and email clients directly.

procurement.label: Purchasing & Procurement
procurement.description: Manage vendor records, purchases, and procurement workflows.
features: Purchase Orders: Raise and track POs against suppliers with discounts.
Vendor Bills: Log purchases, track unpaid bills, and outstanding balances.
Voucher Linking: Record payments and link them directly to purchases.

automation.label: Recurring Billing & Vouchers
automation.description: Automate billing cycles and manage cash flows with payment vouchers.
features: Automated Subscriptions: Auto-generate invoices on daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly schedules.
Downtime Protection: Catch-up logic automatically runs missed jobs upon system restart.
Payment Vouchers: Record receipt and payment logs with custom payment modes.

inventory.label: Inventory & Parties
inventory.description: Organize your products, customers, suppliers, and contacts.
features: Product Catalog: Track cost/selling prices, SKUs, categories, and custom Units of Measure.
Unified Directory: Single source of truth for customers and vendors with GST/PAN tags.
Bulk Imports: Load products and parties in the background via CSV files.

reports.label: Reports & Analytics
reports.description: Get deep insights into your business performance and compliance.
features: Real-Time Stats: Overview of revenue, receivables, and recent activity on login.
Detailed Reporting: Export financial statements and activity reports for audits.
Change History: Persistent activity log and audit trails tracking every edit.

admin.label: Administration & Settings
admin.description: Configure advanced parameters and permissions for your team.
features: Financial Year Rollover: Easily close a financial year and auto-reset sequence numbers.
Organization Settings: Setup logos, bank details, and default terms per company.
Configurable Prefixes: Define custom serial numbering and pools of prefixes.
